init.title: GloBird HA options
init.description: Polling, live grid meters and plan rates. Rates are inferred from your GloBird usage and cost history; pin any you know from the GloBird app (Plan Details).

data_description.daily_poll_start_time: When automatic daily readiness polling resumes after the previous day is ready.
data_description.grid_import_entity: Optional cumulative kWh sensor for energy bought from the grid. Enables Estimated Cost Today and ZeroHero Today.
data_description.grid_export_entity: Optional cumulative kWh sensor for energy sent to the grid. Enables Super Export Remaining Today and caps the export price.
data_description.rate_overrides: Optional. Charge names as the GloBird app shows them, in cents, e.g. Peak Usage: 47.3, Daily Charge: 147.4, Super Export top up - Step1: 10.
data_description.super_export_cap_kwh: Optional. Overrides the inferred daily kWh limit for the Super Export credit.
data_description.zerohero_kwh_per_hour: Optional. Defaults to 0.03 kWh per hour across the ZeroHero window.

error.invalid_rate_overrides: Rate overrides must map charge names to numbers in cents.
